messages.author: Aashish Bhatt
messages.body:
Dear Amber developer
I have a query about the QM/MM module in ambertool.
Can I use the amber QM/MM module with orca software. For this, do I need to
purchase the amber, or is it free?
Kindly guide me for the same.
Best Regards
Aashish

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Jan 13, 2022, Aashish Bhatt wrote:
>
>I have a query about the QM/MM module in ambertool.
>Can I use the amber QM/MM module with orca software. For this, do I need to
>purchase the amber, or is it free?
All of our QM/MM codes are in AmberTools, which has no license fee.
Connections to ORCA are indeed supported: people in my group have used this
combination a lot.
....dac

messages.author: Aashish Bhatt
messages.body:
